import.invalidDescription: {{file}} isn't a Statewright document, or it has errors:
import.replacedDamaged: The copy of {{name}} in this browser couldn't be read; this file replaced it.
import.changedTitle: This file was changed outside Statewright
import.changedDescription: {{file}} was edited after Statewright last saved it. Review what changed, then import it to make it a Statewright document again.
import.unsignedDescription: {{file}} has no Statewright signature, so where it came from can't be checked. Review it, then import it to sign it.
import.existsDescription: This browser has a different version of {{name}}. Choose whether the file replaces it or comes in as a copy.

save.permission: Couldn't write to the file, so it was downloaded instead: {{file}}
